explanation.headline: Sugammadex is not on FDA's shortage list as of 2026-10-21

sentences.text: FDA's records show sugammadex is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale East holds 100 vials of the 100 mg/mL 5 mL presentation with 30.7 days on hand at 3.3 vials per day.
Corvale General holds 61 vials of the same presentation with 14.5 days on hand at 4.2 vials per day.
The labeled manufacturer for NDC 00006542315 is Merck Sharp & Dohme LLC with manufacturing at MSD SUB MERCK.
An alternate manufacturer option ranked by rule is Camber Pharmaceuticals, Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list today and uses Aspiro Pharma Limited, last inspected VAI on 2023-08-11.

Additional alternate manufacturers not on the shortage list include Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Inc. using Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Limited-FTO9 (VAI 2024-05-17) and Somerset Therapeutics, LLC using Solupharm Pharmazeutische Erzeugnisse GmbH (VAI 2022-07-29).

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
